```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Lire le fichier CSSA
CSSA <- read.csv("data/df_binarise_final.csv", sep=";", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# Colonnes OB et SUB
variables_OB <- c("cssdoul", "csshypall", "csstemp", "cssoed", "csseryth", "csssud", "csstroph", "cssforcemoy")
variables_SUB <- c("css2","css3","css4","css5","css6","css7","css8","css9")

# Pivot long pour transformer en format long
CSSA_long <- CSSA %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sid,
    names_to = c("Visit", "Variable"),
    names_pattern = "v(\\d+)_(.*)",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Visit = as.integer(Visit))

# Séparer OB et SUB
CSSA_OB <- CSSA_long %>% 
  filter(Variable %in% variables_OB) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Value)

CSSA_SUB <- CSSA_long %>% 
  filter(Variable %in% variables_SUB) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Value)

# Combiner OB et SUB sur la même ligne
CSSA_final <- CSSA_OB %>%
  left_join(CSSA_SUB, by = c("sid","Visit")) %>%
  rename(
    ID = sid,
    CSS_OB_Pain = cssdoul,
    CSS_OB_Hyperalgesia = csshypall,
    CSS_OB_Temperature = csstemp,
    CSS_OB_Oedema = cssoed,
    CSS_OB_Erythema = csseryth,
    CSS_OB_Sudation = csssud,
    CSS_OB_Trophicity = csstroph,
    CSS_OB_Strength = cssforcemoy,
    CSS_SUB_Pain = css2,
    CSS_SUB_Hyperalgesia = css3,
    CSS_SUB_Oedema = css4,
    CSS_SUB_Erythema = css5,
    CSS_SUB_Sudation = css6,
    CSS_SUB_Trophicity = css7,
    CSS_SUB_Temperature = css8,
    CSS_SUB_Strength = css9
  ) %>%
  mutate(Date = paste0("v", Visit)) %>%
  arrange(ID, Visit)

# Vérifier
head(CSSA_final)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# suppose CSSG_long est ton fichier tuteur
CSSG_long <- read.csv("data/CSS_long.csv", sep=",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# faire un left join
compare <- CSSA_final %>%
  left_join(CSSG_long, by = c("ID", "Visit"), suffix = c(".A", ".G"))

# toutes les colonnes OB et SUB à comparer
cols_to_compare <- grep("CSS_OB|CSS_SUB", colnames(compare), value = TRUE)

# créer des colonnes TRUE/FALSE pour chaque comparaison
for(col in cols_to_compare) {
  col_G <- sub("\\.A$", ".G", col)  # colonne du fichier tuteur
  compare[[paste0(col, "_match")]] <- compare[[col]] == compare[[col_G]]
}

# vérifier si tout correspond
all_cols_match <- sapply(grep("_match$", colnames(compare), value = TRUE), 
                         function(x) all(compare[[x]], na.rm = TRUE))
all_cols_match

# ou afficher uniquement les lignes où il y a au moins une différence
diff_lines <- compare %>%
  filter(if_any(ends_with("_match"), ~ . == FALSE))

diff_lines
```

```{r}
#bland Altman for V1

#création de colonnes moyennes et différences
CSSScores$V1_mean <- (CSSScores$V1_Scoreobj + CSSScores$V1_Scoresubj)/2
CSSScores$V1_diff <- CSSScores$V1_Scoreobj - CSSScores$V1_Scoresubj

# Biais et SD des différences 
mean_diff <- mean(CSSScores$V1_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(CSSScores$V1_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

# Limites d'accord 95%
lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96*sd_diff
upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96*sd_diff

# Plot avec ggplot
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(CSSScores, aes(x = V1_mean, y = V1_diff)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Bland-Altman Plot V1",
       x = "Moyenne des scores (Obj & Subj)",
       y = "Différence des scores (Obj - Subj)")
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Boucle sur toutes les visites
for (v in 1:20) {
  obj_col <- paste0("V", v, "_Scoreobj")
  subj_col <- paste0("V", v, "_Scoresubj")
  mean_col <- paste0("V", v, "_mean")
  diff_col <- paste0("V", v, "_diff")
  
  # Création des colonnes moyenne et différence
  CSSScores[[mean_col]] <- (CSSScores[[obj_col]] + CSSScores[[subj_col]]) / 2
  CSSScores[[diff_col]] <- CSSScores[[obj_col]] - CSSScores[[subj_col]]
  
  # Biais et limites d'accord 95%
  mean_diff <- mean(CSSScores[[diff_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_diff <- sd(CSSScores[[diff_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96*sd_diff
  upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96*sd_diff
  
  # Bland-Altman plot
  p <- ggplot(CSSScores, aes_string(x = mean_col, y = diff_col)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste0("Bland-Altman Plot V", v),
         x = "Moyenne des scores (Obj & Subj)",
         y = "Différence des scores (Obj - Subj)")
  
  print(p)
}
```
